cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Ask Dad why our holiday account's empty. I'll wait by the kitchen door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come with me. You booked the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Ask whether he's angry about the price first. If he isn't, I'll come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm calling you in if he wants the flight receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he wants the total or the breakdown before you call me. The seat upgrades need a longer explanation.
